briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI race to deploy next-gen agents as US tightens export controls on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing agentic systems capable of long-horizon planning. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous decision-making in critical infrastructure.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; xAI launched Grok-4; DeepSeek unveiled R2; Meta iterated Llama-4. Agentic workflows now dominate benchmarks across coding and science tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments; Microsoft and Google expanded hyperscale clusters in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
